_comment: Selected multiplex chains for the Multiplex Report (multiplex_report.py). Add/remove entries here without touching code.
_match: 'match' strings are matched case-insensitively as a substring against each row's 'chain' field (falls back to 'venue' if chain is 'Unknown'/blank). Add extra spellings/typos seen in real BMS data if a theatre isn't showing up.
_match_field: 'match_field': 'chain' (default) matches the theatre chain/company name. 'location' matches the venue name + address instead, useful for grouping several standalone/independent single-screen theatres that share one area/complex but aren't the same chain (e.g. all cinemas at one crossroads).
